# pvecli storage config

Configure storage content types interactively.

```text
pvecli storage config [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
